metadata.title: अबूझमाड़ में चुनाव बहिष्कार के मायने ? Abujhmad: Maoist Again call for election boycott
metadata.description:
Chhattisgarh stands out as the sole state in the upcoming assembly elections, scheduled for November 7 and 17, 2023, that will hold its vote in two phases among the five states preparing for the electoral process. This unique approach is necessitated by the security challenges faced in the Bastar region, which has been significantly affected by Maoist violence. To ensure the safety of both voters and the integrity of the election, additional security measures are being put in place.

In many areas within Bastar, the Maoist party has issued warnings to the Adivasi community, urging them to abstain from participating in the voting process. In light of this, our correspondent ventured into one such area where Adivasis have been called upon to boycott the elections. Let's hear directly from the locals about their thoughts and concerns regarding this situation.
